hints.title: Run-length Scanning
hints.text: Scan the string to identify consecutive segments of identical characters.

hints.title: Segment Chunking
hints.text: For a contiguous run of length count, write chunks of size up to 9 as <size><char>.

hints.title: Remaining Run
hints.text: Subtract 9 from count while count > 9, then output the remainder.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Every character in word is processed once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; single linear scan is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) memory to assemble compressed tokens.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle the maximum chunk limit of 9 cleanly within the two-pointer loop.
